_note: Paid in money in addition to salary. In no salary base until OQ-5 is answered: the definitions do not exclude it by their words, and the cited case law is split (D-094). Salary under the head: S2 s.16 (pp.37–38) "'salary' includes— (a) wages; … (d) any fees or commission; … (f) profits in lieu of, or in addition to, any salary or wages"; TY 2025-26 1961 s.17(1) (thc p.140) "(i) wages; … (iv) any fees, commissions, perquisites or profits in lieu of or in addition to any salary or wages". Which clause covers an allowance is not settled by the words; the engine reads only the head and feedsInto, so nothing turns on it. CASH: paid in money (DR 05 M2).
